training: DEEP-only weights; same1200 training queries for all; matched mixed-L LR/XGB/stateMLP/qvMLP use same cache-miss sample rows and contribution proxy labels. Separate L100 MLP for original P0-A/B, using all L100 cache-miss rows. ET predicts actual prefix GT recall on mixed-L unpruned trajectories.
neural_training: 160 inner epochs, fixed LR .001 through40/.0003 through80/.0001 through120/.00003 through160; choose best internal query loss then refit all1200. Single fixed seed; same17-128-64-1 hidden architecture; qv input401. CPU denormal flushing enabled for numerical underflow performance.
P0_A: L100 beam4; Vanilla, fixed rank>72 and completed>100 heuristic, original L100 MLP, mixed-L LR; each9 repeats; MLP/LR validation retain-FNR1% calibration, not final Recall guarantee.
P0_B: Original L100 MLP and mixed-L LR versions; baseline64 L, heuristic64, ET64, each Gate64 and joint64; joint8 predeclared pairs, not full Cartesian. Shared identical controls measured once, same frozen weights per version.
P0_C: Baseline + matched mixed-L LR/XGB/17DMLP/401DqvMLP,64 configs each; classification and native score diagnostics on same L100 held-out candidate rows.
evaluation: Freeze grid, run full validation; lock per quality/objective before test. Full fixed test grid is descriptive; repeat union of per-objective frontiers, validation-locked choices, exact-common-recall winners and feasible-quality winners to3 until stable. No cost interpolation.
physical_io: Native O_DIRECT request count/bytes and /proc/self/io search-window read_bytes measured. WSL2 guest block bytes, not NAND telemetry.
limits: Previously observed DEEP benchmark queries; exploratory
Finite grid and8 joint pairs; no exhaustive policy-optimality claim
DEEP neural training schedule extended relative to original SIFT P0; not a pure dataset-only change
L100 MLP and mixed-L LR differ in training distribution; pure matched ablation is P0-C
Contribution proxy labels are not counterfactual final-Recall harm labels
ET uses unpruned trajectories; joint can face trajectory shift
Single training seed; repeated search timings do not include training variability
